title: Lamb Pilaf Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry made with lamb, pilaf, and unique spices.

ingredients.name: unique
ingredients.notes: Sesame oil or any other unique oil

instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of unique oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chopped pungent and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
3. Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
5. Stir in the chopped norwegian and cook for an additional 1 minute.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
